name: Kozue Gin
official_name: Nakano BC Japanese Craft Gin Kozue
history: 2017 | Kozue begins shipping on 1 November 2017; first run of 100 bottles, Japan only
notes: Nomunication claims Koyamaki as a world-first gin botanical. 'BC' in Nakano BC stands for 'biochemical'; producer also makes sake, shochu and aged ume/prune wine. Volume 700 ml from Dan Murphy's listing title. Backlog year 2018 vs Nov 2017 launch.
